findings.problem: In this resigned-acceptance sense, eben is the northern and central German particle; in Austria and Switzerland people usually say halt instead, so regional should not be null.
findings.fix: regional: { where: "Austria, Switzerland", text: "halt is the usual particle here (Das ist halt so); eben in this sense sounds northern German." }

back.target: just, simply (modal particle: that's the way things are, no way around it)
back.example: That's just the way it is.

note: The hint rules out halt and einfach, and "the particle" rules out the two-word nun mal (Das ist nun mal so), so only eben is left.
